user.title: Bedtime Sticker Club
user.description: Choose the names for the three checklists. Dinner defaults to 6 pm and bedtime to 7 pm; change these on the Parent settings page. Existing saved YAML progress is imported automatically.

abort.already_configured: Bedtime Sticker Club is already configured.
abort.legacy_package_active: Remove the old Bedtime YAML package include and restart Home Assistant, then add this integration. Your saved stickers will be imported. See the README migration instructions.

set_task.name: Set a bedtime task
set_task.description: Set an explicit completion value for the displayed routine date.

choose_sticker.name: Choose a bedtime sticker
choose_sticker.description: Choose a sticker after completing all three tasks.

sticker.name: Sticker
sticker.description: The emoji to save for this day.
